Weapon of Sorrow.

Precision Kills, Cursed Thrall Explosion Kills, or killing a Poisoned enemy grants 70 Reload Speed, 10% decreased Reload Animation Duration, and trigger a Cursed Thrall Explosion at the target's location.

Cursed Thrall Explosions deal up to <pve 581 /> <pvp [130] /> <arc/>Arc damage and inflict Poison within a ? meter radius. Poison lasts for 3.5 seconds and deals <pve 10 /> <pvp [0.4] /> damage every 0.5 seconds.

Kills with Cursed Thrall Explosions <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine.

Cursed Thrall Explosion and Poison inherit the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.
